    # Connect to database and load data
    conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-001.sqlite')
    query = "SELECT * FROM ch___company_info"
    df = pd.read_sql_query(query, conn)
    conn.close()
    
    # Convert Defaulted to binary (1=Yes, 0=No)
    df['Defaulted_Num'] = df['Defaulted'].map({'Yes': 1, 'No': 0})
    
    # Calculate default rates by credit rating
    print("\n=== DEFAULT RATES BY CREDIT RATING ===")
    default_rates = df.groupby('Credit Rating')['Defaulted_Num'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
    default_rates.columns = ['Default Rate', 'Count']
    print(default_rates)
    
    # Statistical analysis with proper data types
    print("\n=== STATISTICAL ANALYSIS ===")
    try:
        # Prepare numerical data for ANOVA
        groups = [df[df['Credit Rating'] == rating]['Defaulted_Num'] 
                 for rating in df['Credit Rating'].unique()]
        
        # ANOVA test
        f_val, p_val = stats.f_oneway(*groups)
        print(f"ANOVA results: F={f_val:.2f}, p={p_val:.4f}")
        
        # Effect size (Eta squared)
        ss_between = sum(len(g)*(np.mean(g)-np.mean(np.concatenate(groups)))**2 for g in groups)
        ss_total = sum((g-np.mean(np.concatenate(groups)))**2 for g in np.concatenate(groups))
        eta_sq = ss_between/ss_total
        print(f"Effect size (Eta squared): {eta_sq:.3f}")
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Statistical test failed: {str(e)}")
    
    # Enhanced visualizations
    plt.figure(figsize=(15, 8))
    
    # Default rate with confidence intervals
    plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
    sns.barplot(data=df, x='Credit Rating', y='Defaulted_Num',

    plt.title('Default Rate by Credit Rating\n(with 95% CI)')
    
    # Distribution of credit ratings

    plt.title('Enterprise Code Prefix Distribution')
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig('robust_analysis.png')

    # Print summary of anomaly scores
    print("\nAnomaly Score Statistics:")
    print(df['anomaly_score'].describe())
